steps.en: Duplicate or excess payment on a notice is detected
steps.id: Pembayaran ganda atau berlebih pada notice terdeteksi

steps.en: A refund advice record is created with notice and receipt details
steps.id: Record refund advice dibuat dengan detail notice dan receipt
steps.why_en: The record has notice and receipt data only; offender details and approving officer are missing.
steps.why_id: Record hanya berisi data notice dan receipt; detail offender dan approving officer tidak ada.

steps.en: A work item is created for the refund advice
steps.id: Work item dibuat untuk refund advice
steps.why_en: No work item for refunds exists; only a plain refund record is saved.
steps.why_id: Work item untuk refund tidak ada; yang tersimpan hanya record refund biasa.

steps.en: The work item appears in the officer's Cumulus dashboard
steps.id: Work item muncul di dashboard Cumulus officer
steps.why_en: No connection to Cumulus exists in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada koneksi ke Cumulus di code.

steps.en: The officer can review the refund advice
steps.why_en: Officer only sees refund fields inside notice detail; no work item or refund page is active.
steps.why_id: Officer hanya melihat kolom refund di detail notice; tidak ada work item atau halaman refund yang aktif.
